title: P.U. (A) 370/2026 – Income Tax (Deduction for Expenditure in relation to Cost of Renovation and Conversion of Office Premise to Residential House) Rules 2026
summary: New further deduction of 10% of the cost of renovating and converting an office premise into a residential house, incurred from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027, capped at RM10 million in total; effective from YA 2026. The office premise must have been used for administration/office management for more than 10 years and no longer be in use (shophouses excluded); the conversion plan must be approved by the local authority, the house used solely for habitation and rented out after conversion, and the costs certified by an external auditor. Not available if the same costs were claimed under s.33(1) or as capital allowances under Schedule 2 or 3. Made 24/09/2026.

title: P.U. (A) 371/2026 – Service Tax (Digital Services) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Substitutes regulation 16 (hours for submission of return and payment): returns and payment of service tax or penalty through electronic services can be received at any time except during system maintenance, using Malaysian standard time (UTC+8); where the last day falls on a Federal weekly or public holiday in Malaysia, or a weekly or public holiday in the foreign registered person's country, the deadline is that day. In force 28/10/2026; made 22/10/2026. Also published on MySST on 27/10/2026.
replaces: Amends the Service Tax (Digital Services) Regulations 2019 [P.U. (A) 269/2019] by substituting regulation 16

title: Operational Guidelines No. 3/2026 – Applications for Tax Clearance Letters (SPC) for Companies, LLPs and Labuan Entities
summary: HASiL announced new Operational Guidelines (GPO Bil. 3/2026) on applying for a Tax Clearance Letter for companies, LLPs and Labuan entities, now listed under Legislation > Guidelines. It restates that e-SPC applications through MyTax are mandatory (since 1 January 2024), except Labuan entities and SBMJ, which still submit paper SPC forms. HASiL also relabelled its 'For TCL purpose only' 2026 return forms (C, E, TF, PT) in Download Forms.
replaces: Covers the same subject as Guideline No. 1/2022 'Application for Tax Clearance Letter for Companies, LLPs and Labuan Entities' (24/05/2022); the new document does not say explicitly that it replaces it
